description: I don’t self sabotage by over staying my welcome. #selflove #selfimprovement #selfcare
transcript: I do not complain because I'm always willing to change the circumstance. I do not stay anywhere longer than necessary. I will find a solution for everything. I do not carry things that are too heavy. When it is time to put them down, I will always put down the baggage. There's nothing that I'm willing to sit in stress for. I will always move to the next thing. I am in control of this show.
